name: Atrapados en un Videojuego
source:
Snowli and his friends along with his teacher were put inside a video game console. So choose your protagonist! Would you help them get out of the video game console? And meet new friends along the way.

[Edited from [url=https://samkitsune.itch.io/trappedinavideogame]Itch.io[/url]]
